title: Jonah Prays from the Fish
summary: We can pray to God from the deepest trouble. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Jonah 2:1-10 and look for how this passage teaches: We can pray to God from the deepest trouble.

tell_it: Jonah prayed from inside the fish. He remembered the Lord and thanked Him for rescue.
understand_it: We can pray to God from the deepest trouble. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Jonah Prays from the Fish reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. we can talk to God.
age_8_11_explanation: Jonah Prays from the Fish shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: We can pray to God from the deepest trouble.
teen_explanation: Jonah Prays from the Fish gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that we can pray to God from the deepest trouble. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: We can pray to God from the deepest trouble.
God's people can bring real needs and feelings to Him.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when prayer is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Where did Jonah pray from?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Inside the fish. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that we can pray to God from the deepest trouble.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Jonah 2:1 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Jonah Prays from the Fish?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Deep Trouble Prayer
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: We can pray to God from the deepest trouble.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Jonah Prays from the Fish. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
